text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both modestly positive but losing momentum, with BTC up just 0.2% and ETH up 0.5% over 24 hours while altcoins like BNB and SOL slip into negative territory. The Fear & Greed index sits at 68 (Greed) but has declined 3 points over the past week, signaling that euphoria is cooling despite still-elevated sentiment. Bitcoin dominance at 59% and total volume at $55B suggest participants are rotating cautiously rather than committing fresh capital across the board.
